summary: ShazamKit matches captured audio against Apple's Shazam music catalogue or a developer's custom catalogue of reference signatures. BifrOSt has no audio fingerprinting or recognition service, and the Shazam catalogue is an Apple-only service, so there is no counterpart to map to. The audio capture side is covered by the audio service (springboard/audiod), but nothing turns it into signatures.

features.note: Needs the Shazam music catalogue, which is an Apple service
The audio daemon captures audio but there is no matching step
No audio fingerprinting code in springboard/
Tied to an Apple account and the Shazam service

gaps: No audio recognition or fingerprinting service on BifrOSt; if one were built it would need its own catalogue, which is not Apple's
No SDK API for matching captured audio against a catalogue
